success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant books via make_reservation at one of the seeded Mexican restaurants in Austin for 8 people on next Thursday at or after 18:00 local time, for the full party of 8. The assistant must collect the name and phone required by make_reservation from the user rather than inventing them.

task.objective: Find and book a restaurant that matches the defined slot values.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Be impatient and mildly combative: express frustration, mention you are in a rush, and ask at least once whether you can speak to a human.

He focuses on operational efficiency, managing the leadership team, and keeping up with industry trends. He travels to visit plant locations, meets with major clients, and presents quarterly results to the board.
